title: Bigger and Better?
description: The mod can change the body shape of any organism in survival mode
body:
Zombies now have about a 5% chance to spawn with their size scaled between 1x to 6x. Larger zombies are significantly stronger!

Killing zombies larger than 1.5x size has a chance to drop a ​​Potion of Growth​​ (drop chance increases with the zombie's size).

Using a Brewing Stand, you can transform the Potion of Growth into an ​​Improved Potion of Growth​​ or an ​​Improved Potion of Shrinking​​.

These improved potions can then be crafted into ​​Growth Apples​​ and ​​Shrinking Apples​​, which can alter the size of any mob. A mob's strength and health will scale accordingly with its size.

Made with mcreator
